title: Software Technical Leader – Full Stack & AWS Cloud | Ruby, Go, Java & React
teaser: Join our team as a Software Technical Leader to drive the development and scaling of full-stack, distributed solutions for Meraki Dashboard features. Lead end-to-end engineering projects, ensuring reliability and operational excellence. Ideal for experienced technical leaders with expertise in Ruby, Go, Java, React, and AWS Cloud.
description:
Meet the Team

At Cisco Meraki, our intuitive platform enables organizations of all sizes to deliver customer and employee experiences at scale. To provide outstanding technologies to our customers, we've built an outstanding company culture for our employees. One that is collaborative, flexible, and inclusive and provides employees with the autonomy to develop technology that's intuitive, secure, and accessible for everyone.

Our customers use the Meraki web dashboard and programmable APIs to monitor, configure, and automate critical IT infrastructure that serves tens of millions of people every single day!. The Mars team is responsible for bringing Meraki Dashboard features to the Cisco Catalyst family.

Your Impact

Build and scale full-stack, distributed solutions that deliver seamless customer experiences.

Drive reliability, performance, and operational excellence through testing, telemetry, and monitoring.

Own features end-to-end, from design and development through production deployment.

Partner with Engineering, Product, and multi-functional teams to build technical and business priorities.

Solve complex software, networking, and customer issues, continuously improving scalability and reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s, 8+ years with a Master’s, or 5+ years with a PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Development expertise with Ruby on Rails, Golang, Python, or Java/Spring Boot, building scalable backend services, REST APIs, and distributed applications.

Experience with AWS Cloud, crafting and delivering scalable, reliable, and cloud-native applications and services.

Expertise, including modern UI development with React.js or similar frameworks and the ability to work across multiple layers of the technology stack.

Strong experience with networking devices and large-scale distributed networking solutions, including systems software design.

Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, influencing engineering direction, leading complex projects end-to-end, and collaborating across teams to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cisco CML or similar network simulation/emulation platforms.

Proven ability to collaborate optimally across multi-functional and globally distributed engineering teams.

"DigitalTwinHiring"

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx
